vision.name: Krillin
vision.text:
[Continuous]: Whenever a Setup enters play under your control, gain 2 stages. Whenever a Setup or Drill enters play under your control during combat, Rejuvenate 1.
POWER: [Attack] Energy attack costing 2 stages.
Search your Life Deck for a Styled Setup or Styled Drill and place it into play.
DAMAGE: 5 life cards.
HIT: Rejuvenate 3. Choose 3 cards in your opponent's discard pile and banish them.
vision.note: edge reads HERO -> MP; same as S14 P12 (promo has FanZ phrasing 'Banish 3 cards from your opponent's discard pile')
